latin_text: [HARVESTER: from Allen critical translation; source location: Garin edition, Heptaplus proem, pp. 200-210]
english_translation: Whether it [Genesis] is read as an allegory (and thus as Nous, the cosmic intellect encompassing all angelic intelligences), or as an anagogy (mystical union with divine intelligences), or with Kabbalistic eyes (where each day represents emanation of Sefiroth and corresponding angelic powers)...
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico articulates his integrated hermeneutic: Genesis can be read through three complementary angelological lenses. *Allegorically*, Genesis describes the Nous (cosmic intellect) that encompasses all angelic intelligences—creation as the unfolding of divine Intelligence. *Anagogically*, Genesis describes mystical union with divine intelligences—the soul's ascent through angelic communion. *Kabbalistically*, Genesis describes the emanation of the Sefiroth and their corresponding angelic orders—creation as the progressive manifestation of divine attributes through celestial powers.

The philosophical function is methodological: these three readings are not contradictory but complementary layers of the same reality. The Neoplatonic reading grasps the metaphysical structure; the mystical reading grasps the soul's soteriological journey; the Kabbalistic reading grasps the emanational-numerical order. All three converge on angelology as the key to interpreting creation.

[INFERRED] This integrated hermeneutic is the essence of Heptaplus—each of the seven layers reveals angelic being through a different interpretive lens. The Commento works similarly: Books I-IV layer multiple perspectives on angelic transformation. Being & Unity grounds all readings metaphysically: participated being is the single truth accessed through multiple interpretive modes. The Oration integrates all three: philosophical ascent (Nous), mystical transformation (union), and priestly initiation (Kabbalistic degrees).
kabbalistic_elements: **EXPLICITLY KABBALISTIC**: Each day of creation corresponds to Sefiroth and their angelic orders (Sefirah = Angelic throne/Sephirah corresponds to specific Archangel and Choir of Angels).
